API docs by Redocly

SIMJADWAL API v1 (1.0.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:Download

External contract for the desktop app (Tauri) and other token clients.

Rules (status codes, error codes, versioning, real-time events) are in docs/api/CONVENTIONS.md. This file describes request and response shapes only. /api/internal/* is not part of this contract.

  • All JSON fields are snake_case.
  • Single entity and small collection: {"data": ...}.
  • Paginated list: {"data": [...], "meta": {"pagination": {...}}}. per_page default 20, max 100.
  • Every error under /api/* uses ErrorResponse.
  • can_* fields come from server policy. Clients hide actions based on them, not on role.

Auth

Issue a Sanctum token

Rate limited (throttle:login). Wrong password and inactive account return the same error.

Preview or commit an XLSX course import

Two steps. First call with dry_run=true returns a preview and a plan_hash. Then call with dry_run=false and that plan_hash to write. If the plan has errors at commit time, the server returns 422 with the preview body. If the data changed between preview and commit, the server returns 409 IMPORT_PLAN_CHANGED.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
Request Body schema: multipart/form-data
required
study_program_id
required
integer
file
required
string <binary>

.xlsx, max 2 MB

dry_run
required
boolean
plan_hash
string <= 100 characters

Required when dry_run is false

resolutions
string

JSON object mapping a lecturer match key to a lecturer id, e.g. {"budi santoso": 12}

Responses

Only study programs with constraint_status = accepted contribute courses. fingerprint must be sent back as dataset_fingerprint when uploading a run.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
query Parameters
period
string (Period) ^\d{4}/\d{4}-(GANJIL|GENAP)$
Example: period=2026/2027-GANJIL

Defaults to the current period when omitted.

faculty_id
integer

Required for superadmin. Other roles use their own faculty.

Responses

Local (Sail)

http://localhost:8000/api/v1/scheduling/dataset

Create a GA preset

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required
faculty_id
integer

Required for superadmin on create

name
required
string <= 100 characters

Unique per faculty

population_size
required
integer [ 2 .. 10000 ]
min_generations
required
integer >= 1
max_generations
required
integer <= 100000

= min_generations

stagnation_limit
required
integer >= 1
crossover_rate
required
number [ 0 .. 1 ]
mutation_rate
required
number [ 0 .. 1 ]
tournament_size
required
integer >= 2

<= population_size

selection_operator
required
string (SelectionOperator)
Enum: "TS" "TSR"

TS = tournament, TSR = tournament with roulette wheel

parallel_class_limit
required
integer [ 1 .. 100 ]
fitness_constant
required
integer >= 1
base_seed
required
integer >= 0
run_count
required
integer [ 1 .. 10 ]
required
object (ScOverrides)

Per study program soft constraint weights: {"<study_program_id>": {"SC_INGIN": 2.5}}. Only SC codes, weight > 0, program must belong to the faculty.

Upload a finished GA run from the desktop app

Idempotent on client_run_id: a repeat upload returns 200 with the stored run. Returns 409 DATASET_CHANGED when dataset_fingerprint no longer matches the server dataset.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required
client_run_id
required
string <uuid>

Idempotency key

batch_id
required
string <uuid>
faculty_id
integer

Required for superadmin

period
required
string (Period) ^\d{4}/\d{4}-(GANJIL|GENAP)$

Consecutive years. GANJIL schedules odd semesters, GENAP even.

dataset_fingerprint
required
string <= 80 characters
preset_id
integer or null
required
object
best_fitness
required
number
max_fitness
required
number > 0
best_generation
required
integer >= 0
final_generation
required
integer >= 0

= best_generation

fitness_history
required
Array of numbers non-empty
started_at
required
string <date-time>
finished_at
required
string <date-time>
required
Array of objects non-empty
required
Array of objects

Make a run the active schedule of its faculty and period

Roles: admin_fakultas (own faculty), superadmin. Only a done run. The previously active run of the same faculty and period loses is_active and keeps its published_at (archived). The new active run starts unpublished, so only those who may publish it see it in GET /schedules. Repeat calls return 200 unchanged.

409 INVALID_STATE when the run is not done, or when its lecturers or shared rooms clash with the active schedule of another faculty in the same period.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
schedulingRun
required
integer

Responses

Local (Sail)

http://localhost:8000/api/v1/scheduling-runs/{schedulingRun}/activate

Publish the active schedule to lecturers and students

Roles: admin_fakultas (own faculty), superadmin. Sets published_at. 409 INVALID_STATE when the run is not active. Repeat calls return 200 unchanged.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
schedulingRun
required
integer

Official schedule of a period (every role)

Genes of the active run of each visible faculty. Not paginated: a day × session matrix needs all rows.

Visibility:

  • Faculty: superadmin, admin_tpb and dosen read every faculty. Other roles read their own faculty.
  • Unpublished active runs: only superadmin and the admin_fakultas of that faculty.

Default filters (own study program for students and program admins, own lecturer id for lecturers) are set by the client. Export endpoints take the same filters.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
query Parameters
period
string (Period) ^\d{4}/\d{4}-(GANJIL|GENAP)$
Example: period=2026/2027-GANJIL

Defaults to the current period when omitted.

faculty_id
integer
study_program_id
integer
semester
integer [ 1 .. 14 ]
class_number
integer >= 1

Parallel class, 1 = A

course_id
integer
lecturer_id
integer
room_id
integer
day
integer (Day)
Enum: 1 2 3 4 5

1 = Monday ... 5 = Friday

unassigned
boolean

1 = only entries without a room

over_capacity
boolean

1 = only entries whose room is smaller than course.class_capacity

classes[]
Array of strings <= 100 items [^\d+(:\d+)?$]

Picked classes (students have no KRS). 12 = every class of course 12, 12:1 = class A of course 12. Combines with the other filters. Max 100.

Download the schedule as Excel, PDF or iCalendar

Same roles, visibility and filters as GET /schedules, plus format and classes[]. The file holds exactly what GET /schedules returns for the same query. Synchronous download.

  • xlsx: sheet "Matriks" (session x weekday) and sheet "Daftar" (one row per meeting, autofilter).
  • pdf: A4 landscape, matrix then list. Printed by Gotenberg; 503 PDF_UNAVAILABLE when it is down.
  • ics: one weekly event per meeting between the period's start_date and end_date (/academic-periods), time zone Asia/Makassar. UIDs are stable, so re-importing updates events.

Unpublished schedules (visible only to their admins) are marked "DRAF". The file name follows the filters, e.g. jadwal-if-smt3-a-2026-2027-ganjil.pdf, jadwal-dosen-budi-santoso-2026-2027-ganjil.ics.

Typical queries: program admin study_program_id; lecturer lecturer_id (own); student classes[] (picked classes) or study_program_id + semester + class_number.

409 INVALID_STATE when nothing matches, or for ics when the period has no dates.

Where one schedule entry may move (override form)

Roles and 409 as PATCH /schedule-details/{scheduleDetail}. Uses the same hard-constraint checks, against every active schedule and placed TPB class of the period, including faculties the caller cannot see.

Every time slot is listed. available: false comes with the reasons (lecturer busy, class busy, parallel limit, TPB). rooms lists the rooms this faculty may use that fit the class and are free in that slot, smallest first; it is empty when the slot is not available. The entry's own room counts as free.

bearerAuth

scheduleDetail
required
integer

Manual override of one schedule entry

Roles: admin_fakultas (own faculty), superadmin. Only entries of the active run. Only time_slot_id and room_id change. Send both every time; room_id: null leaves the class without a room.

Rejected with 422 when the new place breaks a hard constraint. Checked against every active schedule and placed TPB class of the period:

  • room_id: room of another faculty, room too small, room taken, room used by a TPB class.
  • time_slot_id: lecturer busy (HC2), class already busy (HC3), program over parallel_class_limit (HC4), slot reserved for TPB.

The entry gets is_overridden: true. Its violation logs are deleted because they described the old place. 409 INVALID_STATE when the run is not active.

reason is required (422) when the run is published, because lecturers and students already see it. It is stored in the activity log with the change.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
scheduleDetail
required
integer
Request Body schema: application/json
required
time_slot_id
required
integer
room_id
required
integer or null
reason
string or null <= 500 characters

Required when the run is published
